correctness.rationale: The norm/trace constraint forces y=x=0 for F_q-rational points, yielding unique P=[0:0:1]. The smooth degree-(s+1) plane model has tangent divisor (s+1)P, so every F_q automorphism preserves O_C(1); H^0(C,O_C(1)) has dimension three via restriction sequence for d≥3, even at s=2. Therefore all abstract field-defined automorphisms are projective and fix P and y=0. Comparing polynomial coefficients in the general triangular stabilizer forces norm(u)=1, c/d=−u v^s, trace(w)=−norm(v), and conversely these preserve the form. Norm-one group size s+1 and each trace fiber size s gives total q·s·(s+1)=s³(s+1). Matrix multiplication independently confirms (u,v,w)(uʹ,vʹ,wʹ)=(uuʹ,uvʹ+v,w+wʹ−uv^s vʹ); commutator has s-element trace-zero center. The H_s-invariant field follows from central Z-translations, then X-translations, giving F_q(X^q−X), degree s³ and only infinity ramified. Small-field verifier was read: it checks F4,F9 PGL stabilizers and F25 identities, but no finite test is used as all-prime-power proof.
